diagrams.title: Football Match Manager Data Model
diagrams.description: Entity Relationship Diagram showing the structure of matches, teams, leagues, and users based on the API data models.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
erDiagram
    USER ||--o{ FOLLOW : "creates"
    MATCH ||--o{ FOLLOW : "is followed by"
    LEAGUE ||--o{ MATCH : "hosts"
    TEAM ||--o{ MATCH : "plays in"

    USER {
        uuid id PK
        string email
        string displayName
        url avatarUrl
    }
    MATCH {
        uuid id PK
        string dateTime
        string venue
        string status
        int homeScore
        int awayScore
        string lastUpdated
    }
    TEAM {
        uuid id PK
        string name
        string abbreviation
        url crestUrl
        int foundedYear
    }
    LEAGUE {
        uuid id PK
        string name
        string sport
        string country
        url logoUrl
        string currentSeason
    }
    FOLLOW {
        uuid userId FK
        uuid matchId FK
        string followedAt
        boolean notificationsEnabled
    }

diagrams.title: Match Following Sequence
diagrams.description: Interaction flow for a user to follow a specific football match, including authentication validation.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant API as API Gateway
    participant Auth as Auth Service
    participant DB as Database

    User->>API: POST /follows {matchId: "uuid"}
    API->>Auth: Validate JWT Token
    Auth-->>API: Token Valid (User ID)
    
    API->>DB: Create Follow Record (userId, matchId)
    DB-->>API: Record Created
    
    API-->>User: 201 Created (Follow Response)

diagrams.title: API Request Processing Workflow
diagrams.description: Logic flow for handling incoming API requests, including rate limiting and authentication checks.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    START[Start Request] --> RATE_CHECK{? Rate Limit Exceeded}
    
    RATE_CHECK -- Yes --> ERR_429["Return 429 Too Many Requests"]
    RATE_CHECK -- No --> AUTH_CHECK{? Is Auth Endpoint}
    
    AUTH_CHECK -- Yes --> PROCESS_AUTH["Process Auth Logic (Register/Login)"]
    AUTH_CHECK -- No --> JWT_VAL{? Valid JWT Token}
    
    JWT_VAL -- No --> ERR_401["Return 401 Unauthorized"]
    JWT_VAL -- Yes --> EXECUTE_REQ["Execute Functional Requirement (e.g., API-MATCH-LIST)"]
    
    PROCESS_AUTH --> END[End Request]
    ERR_429 --> END
    ERR_401 --> END
    EXECUTE_REQ --> END

diagrams.title: Requirements Traceability Map
diagrams.description: Mapping of functional API requirements to the underlying data entities they implement.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
flowchart LR
    subgraph "Functional Requirements"
        API-MATCH-LIST["API-MATCH-LIST: Get Match List"]
        API-MATCH-DETAIL["API-MATCH-DETAIL: Get Match Detail"]
        API-FOLLOW-MATCH["API-FOLLOW-MATCH: Follow Match"]
    end

    subgraph "Data Entities"
        ENT-MATCH["ENT-MATCH: Match Object"]
        ENT-TEAM["ENT-TEAM: Team Object"]
        ENT-LEAGUE["ENT-LEAGUE: League Object"]
    end

    subgraph "Cross-Cutting Concerns"
        AUTH-JWT["AUTH-JWT: JWT Authentication"]
    end

    API-MATCH-LIST -->|implements| ENT-MATCH
    API-MATCH-DETAIL -->|implements| ENT-MATCH
    API-FOLLOW-MATCH -->|depends_on| AUTH-JWT
    ENT-MATCH -->|contains| ENT-TEAM
    ENT-MATCH -->|contains| ENT-LEAGUE
